question.wording: Is this item health insurance (an accident and health plan) for the owner, the owner's spouse or dependents, rather than for employees?

options.label: Yes — the owner's own coverage, not a Schedule C expense
No — a benefit program for employees

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item health insurance (an accident and health plan) for the owner, the owner's spouse or dependents, rather than for employees?

citation.wording: Do not include on line 14 any contributions you made on your behalf as a self-employed person to an accident and health plan.
